annotations.title: Add a block to an agenda

description:
Adds one block to an existing agenda: at the end, above a final wrap-up, or directly
after after_block_id.

Adds only — it does not reorder or change any existing block. Returns the full updated
agenda, so no get_agenda call is needed afterwards.

after_block_id.description: Insert directly after this block id. Omit to add at the end.

block_type.description: Internal classification for aggregate analysis, inferred from the content; shown on no BriefMe page.

description.description: Optional one-line note, only when the title is ambiguous.

duration_seconds.description: How long this block runs, in seconds.

edit_token.description: The latest edit_token (from create_agenda, or rotate_edit_token after a rotation). Authorizes on its own; needed unless the agenda is saved to a linked account.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Re-issuing a call with the same key and the same arguments returns the original result instead of repeating the change — send the same key when re-issuing a request whose response was lost. A fresh UUID per call works well; only a retry repeats one.

share_token.description: Agenda id (from create_agenda or list_agendas). Required with a linked account, optional beside edit_token.

title.description: Short, active, scannable on a countdown screen.

name: add_block

blocks.description: The blocks in the order they run.

block_type.description: Internal classification; appears on no BriefMe page.

id.description: Stable 8-letter id: what update_block, remove_block, reorder_blocks and after_block_id take.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601. null when the agenda is saved to an account and does not expire.

share_token.description: The agenda's public identifier; what every tool takes as share_token.

share_url.description: The read-only agenda with the live timer; safe to give to attendees.
